welcome.subject: Welcome to Kensington Corporate — {{accountName}} Go-Live
welcome.attachments: the {{obt}} training guide and the Kensington Corporate contact sheet
welcome.body:
KENSINGTON CORPORATE  |  WELCOME
---

Hi {{names:contacts:Travel Manager}},

We're thrilled to officially welcome you and your Team at {{accountName}} to Kensington Corporate!

Today is go-live day, and your {{obt}} Travel site is officially up and running. We're excited to begin supporting your travellers and to build a long and successful partnership with {{accountName}}.

Below are a few helpful details to get everyone started. As always, please don't hesitate to reach out to us with any questions — we're here to help!

## Signing in to {{obt}}
{{#if obt=Deem}}
[Deem sign-in instructions: add them by editing the Welcome Letter template]
{{else}}
{{#if signOn=SSO}}
Visit concursolutions.com and sign in with your company single sign-on (SSO), using your usual company credentials.
{{else}}
Visit concursolutions.com and sign in using your company email address. You can set up two-factor authentication or request an email sign-in link, which we recommend.

If you request an email link, you should receive an email from Concur within a few seconds.
{{/if}}
{{/if}}

## Review and update your {{obt}} profile
Please visit your profile in the upper-right corner of {{obt}} and confirm that all of your information is accurate and complete.

This includes:
- Name and contact information
- TSA/Passport information
- Travel preferences
- Mobile phone number
- Any other required profile fields

All mandatory fields are clearly marked and must be completed before making a reservation.

## Loyalty and rewards program information
{{#if loyalty=Migrated}}
Frequent flyer numbers, hotel rewards numbers, rental car loyalty numbers, and other travel program information were migrated from your previous TMC to Kensington Corporate. Please review them to make sure everything is accurate and complete.
{{else}}
Frequent flyer numbers, hotel rewards numbers, rental car loyalty numbers, and other travel program information did not migrate from your previous TMC to Kensington Corporate.

We recommend reviewing your profile and adding or updating this information before making your first reservation so your loyalty details are available when booking.
{{/if}}

## Use the training guide if you need a refresher
We've attached a quick {{obt}} training guide covering profile updates and booking air, hotel, and car reservations.

Feel free to share the guide with anyone at {{accountName}} and/or post it on your company intranet.{{#if obt=Concur}} Concur training videos are also available through SAP Concur.{{/if}}

## Agent Support
We've also attached our Kensington Corporate contact sheet, which includes our hours of operation, phone numbers, and helpful email addresses. This can also be shared with your travelers and/or posted on your company intranet.

{{#if region=USA}}
[US support details: add the hours, phone numbers and email by editing the Welcome Letter template]
{{else}}
Monday–Friday: 8:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m. ET
Agent Support: 855-249-8121 or 416-649-9091
Email: canada@kensingtoncorporate.com
24/7 Emergency Support: 888-481-2012 or 647-288-3057
{{/if}}

Please note that 24/7 emergency support is available by phone only. Our email inboxes are not monitored outside of regular business hours.

While our entire team is committed to supporting {{accountName}}, {{leadAgent}} will be your lead agent and primary point of contact for your travelers.

When emailing {{#if region=USA}}[US support email]{{else}}canada@kensingtoncorporate.com{{/if}}, please put ATTN: {{leadAgent}} at the top of your email. If {{first:leadAgent}} is unavailable, another member of our team will be happy to assist.

Having a dedicated lead agent allows us to become familiar with {{accountName}}, your travelers, and your program so that we can provide increasingly personalized support as our partnership grows.

{{#if csm}}
## Dedicated Customer Success Manager
{{csm}} is your dedicated Customer Success Manager and will be your primary partner for everything beyond day-to-day travel bookings: helping you navigate your program, answering questions, coordinating with our teams, and making sure you're getting the most value from your partnership with Kensington Corporate.

{{first:csm}} can be reached at {{csmEmail}} or {{csmPhone}}.

{{/if}}
{{#if accountNotes}}
## Specific to {{accountName}}
{{accountNotes}}

{{/if}}
## {{obt}} Site Support
If you experience an issue with the site or notice that something is not displaying correctly, please contact our Online Support Team:

Email: onlinesupport@kensingtoncorporate.com
Phone: 877-218-5388

Thank you again for choosing Kensington Corporate. We're incredibly excited to have {{accountName}} officially live and look forward to supporting your team every step of the way.

Here's to a great start and a successful partnership!

Thank you,

{{signoffNames}} & the entire Kensington Corporate team

tm.label: Travel Manager next steps
tm.subject: Next steps for your Travel Managers — {{accountName}}
tm.attachments: the {{obt}} Administrator Guide and the self-registration step-by-step guide
tm.body:
KENSINGTON CORPORATE  |  NEXT STEPS
---

Hi {{names:contacts:Travel Manager}},

Now that {{accountName}} is officially live with Kensington Corporate, we wanted to share a few resources and next steps specifically for your team as Travel Managers.

We're excited to officially begin this next phase of our partnership and look forward to working closely with you as your program gets underway. The first few weeks are an important time to let bookings flow through the new program, make sure everything is working as expected, and start building a clear picture of your travel activity.

## {{obt}} Administration
Attached is the {{obt}} Administrator Guide, which provides an overview of the tools and functionality available to you as Travel Managers. We recommend keeping this guide handy as you become familiar with your new environment.

If you have questions along the way or need assistance with an administrative function, our team is always happy to help.

## Self-Registration
We've also provided information on self-registration, along with a step-by-step guide attached to this email.

Self-registration can be used to ensure travelers who are new to the program are able to establish their profiles and access {{obt}}. Please feel free to share these instructions with your team as needed.

{{accountName}} Self-Registration Link: {{selfRegLink}}

## Kensington Corporate Analytics
One of the exciting next steps will be getting you set up with Kensington Corporate Analytics, our reporting and analytics platform.

We'll schedule a dedicated training session for approximately four weeks after go-live. Waiting a few weeks allows the platform to begin populating with actual booking data, giving us the opportunity to walk through the reporting tool using your own program activity.

In the meantime, we encourage you to let your travelers begin booking through {{obt}} and our agent team as normal. The more activity we have flowing through the program, the more meaningful your initial reporting and analytics session will be.

We'll be in touch closer to the four-week mark to coordinate a training date and make sure the session is tailored to your needs.

## What's Next
For now, the key priorities are:
- Familiarize yourselves with the {{obt}} Administrator Guide
- Share the self-registration information with your travelers and internal teams as appropriate
- Allow bookings to begin flowing through the program
- Watch for our outreach to schedule your Kensington Corporate Analytics training approximately four weeks post-go-live

As always, please reach out if anything comes up during the transition. We're here to make sure you feel confident managing the program and have the support and resources you need from day one.

We're excited to see {{accountName}} officially live and look forward to working with you as we continue to build and optimize your travel program together!

Thank you,
{{tmSignoff}}
